question: Should selected Discord role mentions wake every accessible agent configured for that role, and what limits should apply to multi-agent fan-out and bot-authored messages?
rationale: This changes deliberate activation policy and can trigger several agents from one message; source behavior cannot determine the intended product contract safely.

options.title: Add selected wake roles
options.body: Add an opt-in guild/channel role-ID list with explicit fan-out, access-control, other-mention, and bot-loop semantics.

options.title: Recognize only managed bot roles
options.body: Treat only each bot's Discord-managed role as equivalent to its direct user mention, solving autocomplete ambiguity without general group activation.

options.title: Keep direct mentions only
options.body: Continue requiring individual bot mentions and document role mentions as non-wake metadata.

recommendation.title: Add selected wake roles
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in guild/channel role-ID list with explicit fan-out, access-control, other-mention, and bot-loop semantics.
